To avoid the DST mismatch I have two practical options (pick whichever is easiest):
  - Option A: Keep Oct 27 and confirm 14:00 UTC (that maps to 16:00 CEST / 15:00 BST)
  - Option B: Move to Tue Nov 3 at 09:00 UTC (avoids the DST boundary entirely; Kenji will be back from travel)

Olga — can you cover the runtime demo on either slot? Priyom — want to join for architecture Qs?

Sophie — leaving HubSpot deal open (SM-4821), will create the calendar invite once we pick a slot. Also linking the agenda here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/agenda123 (attached copy included).
